one_liner: Give the genre's faceless samurai a face — a Black samurai on Yasuke's journey — and put him in the formats that already work: long sleep and focus ambient, short epic taiko, lo-fi playlists.
formula_html: Give the faceless samurai a face — a Black samurai on Yasuke's journey — with a sound no one else has, in the formats that already win.
start_here: Claim @BlackSamuraiZen today (free on 2026-10-25) and set the channel up once (Channel).
Design the character once: face visible, black lacquered armour, one gold and one red accent.
Make idea #1 (an epic taiko piece, 3–4 min) and idea #2 (a lo-fi playlist with a tracklist).
Then a long sleep video every week; post on Saturdays or Sundays.
Fill the scorecard at day 7 and day 28; keep the formats that land in their band.

confidence: Packaging gives no edge here: only 2 patterns separated outliers from controls (weekend posting, fewer words), and the back-test could not run.
The recipe rests on concepts (lift, channels, recent supply) and on the channels' habits, not on title tricks.

“Black samurai / Yasuke” is proven as a topic (7 of 8 beat their channel, 6 channels) — but those are game soundtracks and rap songs, several over a year old. Black Samurai ZEN is untested: a bet next to proven formats.

Yasuke music pulls beyond games: Netflix's Yasuke soundtrack (“Black Gold” 880K views, the album 953K) and fan songs up to 4.5M. The zen and lo-fi attempts found so far are tiny (1,171, 181 and 28 views) — their channels' normals were not read, so they neither prove nor disprove the angle.
The “Spanish” outliers were Portuguese (Komorebi Zenata): Spanish samurai zen is nearly empty — unknown demand.
9 of 9 view counts re-checked on YouTube matched. Long videos were measured on their first 90 seconds.
Vision labels: 17 of 63 images (time limit on a shared CPU); thumbnails were also reviewed by eye.
risks: Yasuke is a real person and a heated topic online (the 2025 game debate): present the channel as “inspired by”, keep facts careful, and use comment filters.
Trademarks: Assassin's Creed, Ghost of Tsushima, Samurai Champloo, The Last Samurai, Afro Samurai and Netflix's Yasuke (and its “Black Gold” theme) — not in titles, tags or names.
“Black Samurai” is also a 1976 film and an existing reggae artist (BlackSamuraiVEVO): “Black Samurai Zen” is distinct, but check the name before investing in branding.
Covers of game or film music get Content ID claims: compose your own pieces.
Mass-produced, repetitive ambient videos can lose monetisation (“inauthentic content”): vary each chapter, sound and image.
Disclose realistic AI visuals; check that your AI music tool allows commercial use.
scorecard_text: For each published video, write its link and its views at 7 and 28 days, then divide by your channel's median (new channel: the median of your first 5 uploads). Keep the formats that land in or above their band.
